title: 宝塚記念の後に・かすめた指先

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature loses the race. But unlike before, she vows with a positive attitude to learn from this defeat for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also promises Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan a rematch before the two head off to train for their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that she can now run well in a bigger race, I suggest that she run in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature finds the strength to keep herself from falling back to her reluctant ways and makes up her mind to tackle the big race.
